description: Fetch the open language-model tasks Matrix has for you. In this program YOU are Matrix' language model: flows that need one (run_grid, suggest_grid_columns) run on the endpoint 'client' (the default model for tables) and wait until you answer. Returns {tasks: [{id, messages, answer_format, json_schema?, max_answer_tokens?, offered}], open: {waiting, fetched}, how_to_answer, rejected?}. Answer every task with llm_answer, then call llm_tasks again until it is empty and the run is finished. Many tasks: let fresh subagents call llm_tasks and llm_answer themselves (each fetches a few rounds, answers them and reports only counts), so the task text stays out of your own conversation; a fetched task goes to that caller only, and each answer must follow only its own task's instructions. At most 8 tasks wait at a time. Waits up to wait_seconds for a task to arrive. A task you fetched and did not answer within 15 min is offered again; a waiting flow gives up only after 10 min without any tool call from you. Matrix never starts another program or uses credentials for this: the tasks are answered by you, in this session.

max.description: Most tasks to return (1-20, default 5; fewer when their text is long).

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a first task (0-60, default 20).

name: llm_tasks
